title: Coalition teams up with Labor to pass 20% gas reservation scheme for Australia’s largest exporters
summary: Labor passes final major piece of legislation for 2026, denying Greens’ bid for 25% tax on exports Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast A federal gas reservation scheme requiring Australia’s largest exporters to keep up to 20% of their product for domestic use will go ahead with the Coalition’s support. The opposition waved through the government’s plans in the in a late night Senate sitting on Thursday night, giving Labor the numbers it needed. title: Qantas and Air New Zealand planes too close at Sydney airport as ‘mental models’ of crews to be investigated
summary: Aborted descent on Wednesday morning is latest in a series of landing incidents at Sydney airport Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Australian Transport Safety Bureau is investigating flight crews’ “mental models” after a Qantas plane aborted its landing at Sydney airport on Wednesday after noticing another aircraft crossing the runway while on its descent. summary: Brisbane supreme court jury finds Robert John Crawford guilty of murder after he stood to lose financially in divorce settlement Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Former air force pilot Robert John Crawford has been found guilty of the murder of his wife after a jury accepted her death was staged as a fatal lawnmower accident. title: Water firms to identify 250,000 vulnerable households in England eligible for discounts
summary: Department for Work and Pensions to provide data about households missing out on WaterSure support scheme Water companies will use government data to identify as many as 250,000 vulnerable households in England eligible for discounts, after criticism that not enough people are aware of the £428 support for their annual bills. The Department for Work and Pensions will provide information to identify and contact a quarter of a million households who are missing out on support to which they are entitled under the WaterSure scheme . title: Up to 1.4m UK workers risk missing out on zero-hours shake-up, say unions
summary: Andy Burnham is warned against calls from bosses to water down employment rights legislation Andy Burnham is being warned that 1.4 million workers will be at risk of being stuck in insecure jobs if a forthcoming ban on zero-hours contracts is watered down. The prime minister is under pressure from business leaders to scale back last year’s Employment Rights Act, which is being introduced in stages over 2026 and 2027. Continue reading...

title: Mad about mara: the DIY dance movement helping young Nigerians escape the daily grind
summary: What started as one artist’s response to being cut out of a music video has exploded, becoming a driving force in Nigeria’s cultural landscape As a student in the central Nigerian city of Ilorin, Lawal Habeeb Kola loved staying in his hostel room to produce beats rather than returning to his family house in Lagos, the more frenetic city of his birth. In 2022, one of his beats became popular on TikTok, and a version featuring ad-libbed vocals from a hypeman sent it viral. He was invited to the music video shoot in Lagos and thought his big break had finally come, but when the video was released, he was absent. Continue reading...

title: Nearly half of ethnic minority people in UK have faced racism at work in last year, survey finds
summary: Figures show impact on mental health, with majority having no confidence HR will take their concerns seriously Nearly half of people from minority ethnic backgrounds have experienced racism at work and the majority have no confidence that HR would take their concerns seriously, a survey has found. It also found that 75% of people from the UK’s five largest minority ethnic communities had experienced racism or unfair treatment linked to their race, ethnicity or religion in the previous year, and three-quarters of those who had experienced racism said it had affected their mental health to some degree. title: New Zealand election: final results show ruling coalition needs minor party to govern
summary: Incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon loses majority and needs support of Opportunity party to remain in power, or country faces another election The final results of New Zealand’s general election show the incumbent rightwing coalition will need the support of a centrist newcomer party to form a government, and to avoid sending the country back to the polls. Preliminary results on 7 November handed the National party and its two coalition partners, the populist New Zealand First and libertarian Act parties, a slim two-seat majority, making the election too close to call until final votes were tallied. title: Race hate exploded in this Spanish town last year. Now its residents are bracing for more
summary: Torre-Pacheco’s diverse communities are fearful that the far-right Vox party will enter government after Sunday’s election Sitting on a park bench, taking in the sunny day, Naima reflected on all that had seemingly changed since she moved to Spain three decades earlier. Back then, the Moroccan national had felt warmly welcomed by Spaniards. “I had never, at any point in my life, felt like there was racism,” she said. “But now things are changing. And the blame lies with rightwing politics.” Continue reading...

title: Threat from China looms large over Taiwan’s local elections
summary: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage. Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. Unlike the presidential elections, in which foreign policy is often a key issue, the local elections, held every four years , are largely focused on bread-and-butter issues such as housing affordability and wealth distribution.
